name: Byouin ~Choukyou Karte~
source:
When the hospital director dies suddenly in an accident, a new director is appointed to the position. The new director sets out a new hospital management policy of giving more priority to money over patients.

Chizuru and her friends vehemently protest against this, directly appealing over and over again to the reconsideration of the policy, only to be turned down.
And the director, sick of the appeals coming time and time again, hands down an order to the pharmacist, Taeko.

A short visual novel featuring a female doctor being trained in confinement.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ034460.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
院长突然因事故去世，继任者获任新院长，随即提出新的经营方针，将金钱置于病人之上。

千鹤与同伴们强烈反对，多次直接请求重新考虑这项方针，却一再遭到拒绝。
院长厌烦了接连不断的请愿，向药剂师多惠子下达了一道命令。

一部描写女医生被囚禁调教的短篇视觉小说。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ034460.html]DLsite英文页面[/url]]
